translations.translatedText: # Wednesday 27.10.2021 (radio)
Sexual harassment in the rescue sector. Prime Minister Marin visited Germany. The number of postal parcels. Fuel surcharge on ship trips. Weather forecast.
## Sexual harassment in the rescue sector

![Inside an emergency vehicle, another fire engine comes towards it.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1920,h_1080,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-769951601baa0277304/1612425831)
Open image viewer
Harassment can be speech that does not feel pleasant. Photo: Risto Koskinen / Yle
Women face harassment at work in rescue services and in emergency care, that is, ambulance work.

Yle has interviewed women who have worked in the rescue sector. They say that the harassment has been, for example, speech that does not feel pleasant. The harassment has been, for example, talk about sex, sexual touching or belittling of women.
The management of Finland's rescue sector and rescue sector organisations are worried about the matter. They say that harassment of women in the rescue sector must be addressed.
## Marin visited Germany
![Sanna Marin and Angela Merkel.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12161917)
Open image viewer
Prime Minister Sanna Marin and Chancellor Angela Merkel. Photo: Filip Singer / EPA
Prime Minister Sanna Marin has met the Prime Minister of Germany, that is, the Chancellor Angela Merkel, in Berlin.
At the meeting they talked, for example, about the EU's relations with other countries, climate change and the rule of law situation in Poland.
Finland's Prime Minister Marin and Germany's Chancellor Merkel also talked about energy matters, the corona situation and the economy.
## The number of postal parcels is growing
![Post sorting centre in Vantaa](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3078,x_0,y_325/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-82980760e6af6e63707/1625730990)
Open image viewer
Parcels at the Post's sorting centre in Vantaa. Photo: Markku Rantala / Yle
The number of postal parcels continues to grow fast. Posti delivered 17 million parcels in Finland and the Baltics in July–September. There were 2 million more parcels than a year ago.
A lot of parcels are sent. However, Posti has a shortage of employees. Online shopping is growing, and that is why the number of postal parcels is growing.
Instead, the number of letters is decreasing. In July–September, 8 per cent fewer letters were sent than a year ago.
## Fuel surcharge on ship trips
![Car ferry Viking Gabriella at sea.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3078,x_0,y_573/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-85587461484dd0b954d/1722436751)
Open image viewer
M/S Gabriella sails between Helsinki and Stockholm. Photo: Petteri Bülow / Yle

The ship company Viking Line is introducing a fuel surcharge. The reason is that the price of oil has risen a lot. That is why running ships is more expensive than before. The corona situation has also worsened the economy of ship companies, because travel has decreased a lot.
The fuel surcharge is 90 cents one way between Helsinki and Tallinn. On ship trips between Finland and Sweden the fuel surcharge is just under 2 euros one way.
Viking Line will start charging passengers a fuel surcharge in November.
## Weather
![Thursday's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12163120)
Open image viewer
There is frost and snow in Lapland.

On Thursday it snows in Lapland, Koillismaa and Kainuu. In the west it rains a little or drizzles. Elsewhere the cloud cover may break, that is, the sun may shine at times. The temperature is between 4 and 11 degrees, in the north between -5 and +4 degrees.
